Issue type for a user story.","iconUrl":"https://toastboy.atlassian.net/images/icons/issuetypes/story.svg","name":"Story","subtask":false,"hierarchyLevel":0},"components":[],"created":"2026-07-31T15:08:12.196+0100","description":"Follow-on from the SYS-584/586 Container/Paper audit. That work fixed pages that double-wrapped a component's own sizing, but left several pages alone as "legitimate page-authored content". A full repo grep (`grep -rl "from '@mantine'" src/app --include="page.tsx"`) shows the real scope is much larger: **23 page.tsx files** import directly from Mantine, not 5.

**Goal:** generalise the rule fully — a `page.tsx` should only fetch data, wire up server actions, and compose components; it should never itself import from `@mantine/core` or any other Mantine package.

**Scope, grouped by pattern:**

1. **Static page-authored content → own component.** No reusable data component to fold sizing into; the page IS the content. Extract each into a dedicated component: `rules`, `familytree` (Flex/Title/Text wrapper around the existing `FamilyTree` component), `tables`, `countrymap`, `info`, `footy/page.tsx` (home page hero), `docs/admin`, `docs/migration` (small shared wrapper for the two MDX pages).
2. **Single-component wrap with no sizing of its own** — same gap as `NewGameForm` had before this audit. `turnout/page.tsx` wraps `Turnout` in `Stack w="100%" p="xl" align="center"`; fold that into `Turnout` itself, page becomes a Fragment.
3. **Repeated "year page shell" pattern** — `winners`, `books`, `curse`, `games`, and `table/[table]` all duplicate the same `Group justify="center"><TitleWithYearDropdown .../></Group>` (plus an outer `Stack`/`Flex`) around one data component. This is a strong candidate for a single shared component (e.g. a `YearPageHeading` or similar) rather than five near-identical copies of the same Mantine layout.
4. **Repeated error/status notification pattern** — `auth/accountdeleted`, `auth/reset-password` (missing-token branch), `auth/claim/[token]` (invalid-invitation branch), `downloadmydata` (two branches), `profile` (two branches), and `admin/users` (fetch-error branch) all render a `<Notification icon={<IconX/>} color="red"/"blue">{message}</Notification>` (or, for `response/page.tsx`, a `Box`+`Text`+`Anchor` variant) directly in the page. Extract a single shared component (e.g. `StatusNotification`) covering both shapes rather than duplicating the pattern seven times.
5. **Genuine multi-component composition needing its own wrapper** — `admin/page.tsx` (dashboard: two independent admin widgets in a `Flex`) and `game/[id]/page.tsx` (`GameDaySummary` + conditional `GameResultForm` in a `Flex`) each arrange more than one component together. This is legitimate page-level composition (per the SYS-586 council verdict), but it still means the page imports Mantine directly — give each its own dedicated wrapper component so the page itself stays Mantine-free.

**Also still in scope from the original ticket:**

* Extend the existing ESLint override at `eslint.config.mjs` (`files: ["src/app/**/page.{ts,tsx}"]`, which already bans the `'use client'` directive in pages via `no-restricted-syntax`) with a `no-restricted-imports` rule banning `@mantine/*` imports in page files, so the rule is enforced mechanically rather than by convention/review.

**Acceptance criteria:**

* No `page.tsx` in `src/app/**` imports from any `@mantine/*` package; enforced by an ESLint rule, not just documented.
* Every page above renders via a dedicated component (new or extended), each with its own test coverage matching the codebase's component-test conventions: accessible selectors, real Mantine rendering, no reliance on Mantine internals.
* `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, and `npx knip` all clean.

content.text:
Looked at SYS-600 and the current ESLint config — worth noting the ban isn't live yet (only the `'use client'` restriction is enforced today in the pages override); the `no-restricted-imports` rule for `@mantine/*` in pages is what this ticket proposes adding.

My take: keep the blanket ban. The RSC dot-notation bug itself doesn't require it (that only bites property access on a `'use client'` export, so a page importing `Flex` directly and composing two components inside it wouldn't trigger it) — but the real value is that "pages only fetch, wire actions, and compose" becomes mechanically enforceable rather than a per-PR judgment call, which matches how this codebase already handles the client/server split (categorical rule over case-by-case exception, per the `require-use-client` rationale in CLAUDE.md). The cost is genuinely minor boilerplate for case 5 in the ticket (`admin/page.tsx`, `game/[id]/page.tsx`) — a one-line `Flex` wrapping two components now needs its own wrapper file and test, even though nothing there is reusable or complex enough to *need* isolation on its own merits.

Want me to start on the extraction work, or do you want to revisit the ticket's scope first?
How many pages would need to change? How many new components needed?

content.text:
Verified against the current tree (not just the ticket text, which is 2 weeks old): **23 `page.tsx` files** still import from `@mantine/*` and would need to change — same number the ticket cites, confirmed by `grep -rl "from '@mantine" src/app --include="page.tsx"`.

Two things the ticket mentions have already been resolved on `main`:
- `game/[id]/page.tsx` — already a pure Fragment (`AutoRefresh` + `GameDaySummary`), the exact pattern group 5 asks for.
- `docs/admin` / `docs/migration` — already import only their `.mdx` content, no Mantine import in the page itself, so no wrapper needed there.

For the 23 remaining, grouped by the ticket's own categories and re-verified by grep:

| Group | Pages | New components |
|---|---|---|
| 1. Own dedicated component (static content) | `rules`, `familytree`, `tables`, `countrymap`, `info`, `footy/page.tsx` (home) — 6 | 6 (one each) |
| 2. Fold into existing component | `turnout` — 1 | 0 (edit `Turnout` itself) |
| 3. Shared "year page shell" | `winners`, `books`, `curse`, `games`, `table/[table]` — 5 | 1 (`YearPageHeading` or similar) |
| 4. Shared status-notification | `auth/accountdeleted`, `auth/reset-password`, `auth/claim/[token]`, `auth/claim/[token]/finish`, `auth/verify/enquiry/[token]`, `auth/verify/extra-email/[token]`, `downloadmydata`, `profile`, `admin/users`, `response/[token]` — 10 | 1 (`StatusNotification`, covering both the `Notification` and `Box+Text+Anchor` shapes) |
| 5. Dedicated wrapper, genuine composition | `admin` (dashboard) — 1 | 1 |

**Totals: 23 pages changed, 9 new components** (plus the ESLint `no-restricted-imports` rule extension itself).

Note groups 1–2 & 4's real per-page count came out slightly different from the ticket's prose (which undercounted the notification group — it's 10, not 7, once `claim/[token]/finish`, `verify/enquiry`, and `verify/extra-email` are included) but the total of 23 pages still matches.
